record.name: Belize
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. In June 2026 the government said it was taking first steps towards a national AI policy and proposed hosting a regional AI hub for Central America.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the intended national AI policy, the proposed regional AI hub and e-governance work on responsible AI adoption. Reviewed the government press release as primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

searches.query: Belize national AI safety institute model evaluation government 2026
Belize national artificial intelligence policy 2026 Ministry of Economic Transformation

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: BZ-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government's July 2026 press release says Belize intends to advance the development of a national AI policy for innovation, digital transformation and economic competitiveness, with the Ministry of Economic Transformation engaging development partners. The e-governance portal records regional dialogue on ethical AI frameworks. Neither describes a body to evaluate advanced models.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Economic Transformation
related_bodies.role: It announced the intention to develop a national AI policy; it has no evaluation mandate.

record.notes:
The government's earlier press release describes an intention to develop a national AI policy and a proposed regional AI hub. The opened digital-agenda page did not mention AI.

The e-government portal records regional responsible-AI policy dialogue and public-sector capacity building. The regional dialogue concerns practical, ethical and people-centred AI frameworks. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of gov.bz.

next_check.reason: Check whether the national AI policy has been drafted.
